items.title: squads audit: inventory the org root — not in git, undeclared, unmeasured, untrue docs, retired names, duplicate documents

check.ci: fixture org root → exactly the expected finding classes
check.live: fresh squads init project → no crash; every unit unclassified with a hint

items.title: Feature lists as code: .agents/features.json schema; squads plan aggregates every repo's file

check.ci: schema validates fixtures; squads plan --json totals equal the sum of the files
check.live: squads plan over a real org root lists every repo's items

items.title: Release train ships an outcome: refuses unless every item for the release passes with a verification by a model other than the builder's

check.ci: fixture features.json with one failing item → train refuses; all passing with valid verifications → release PR opens

verifications.evidence: https://github.com/agents-squads/squads-cli/pull/1324#issuecomment-6288409492; live: dry run against the real roadmap refused O0 naming the one failing item

items.title: Provider errors are caught and named: plan expired, quota, auth fail fast; rate limit and overload back off

check.ci: recorded real provider error bodies → type + retry decision
check.live: an invalid credential ends the run in < 10 s with the typed reason in the run record

items.note: merged 550636c (3 review rounds, DeepSeek). Live: typed + recorded OK, but 213 s vs < 10 s (harness-internal retries) — failing until fixed; see #1298 comment

items.title: Run status is true: no run left running, no success on an error

check.live: reconcile the last 7 days of runs → 0 status mismatches

verifications.evidence: https://github.com/agents-squads/squads-cli/pull/1339#issuecomment-6287015349; live: squads runs reconcile on the real ledger → 0 rows running without a live pid (was 1), 626 runs all terminal

items.title: Run events carry schema_version; reasoning and whole tool calls are recorded for every harness

check.ci: contract tests: each consumer validates events from the release candidate
check.live: one run per harness → reasoning, tool_call.args, tool_result.text whole and redacted

items.title: Non-Claude lanes are contained: writes outside the worktree and credential-directory reads are blocked and recorded

check.ci: sandbox profile tests (macOS seatbelt, Linux bwrap)
check.live: a lane that tries both is blocked twice and the blocks show in its events

items.title: Credential contract: each provider declares its modes (subscription login, API key, free), validated at dispatch

check.ci: no credentials → exits before spawn with a typed error naming what is missing
check.live: a key or a login → the run starts

items.title: squads providers: mode in use, account, plan or balance, last error per provider

check.ci: fixture matrix (key only / login only / both / neither) matches the output

items.title: Lanes run on the user's choice of account: free models, subscriptions, API keys

check.ci: per-lane unit tests on routing and env
check.live: one live run per lane: worktree, harness recorded, reconciled outcome, cost recorded

items.title: Works without GitHub: GitHub-only commands degrade with a clear message

check.ci: no gh on PATH + non-GitHub remote → runs work; GitHub-only commands explain and exit 0
a command prints weekly active installs per version

items.title: An agent's setup is a typed tree of 8 components (system prompt, guardrails, memory, tool guidance, subagents, skills, scripts, plugins); edits are diffs where omitted means inherited

check.ci: round-trip read → validate → write on every agent in a fixture org; a one-component proposal changes only that component

items.title: Propose–Probe–Compose: variants of one agent run on the same task and are composed from behavioural contrasts, without a grader

check.ci: fixture task: proposals, probes and composition are recorded with their evidence
check.live: on held-out tasks a third model's blind choice prefers the composed agent at a pre-registered rate

items.title: Experience library per squad: each adopted setup (whole tree), why it won, the lesson

check.ci: after an H2 step the library holds tree + note; the next step starts from it

items.title: Anti-gaming: grader output and answer keys never reach the proposer; selection is blind to which model built what

check.ci: a context containing a planted verdict or answer key is refused; the selector sees anonymised outputs only

items.title: Budget ledger: expected runs per improvement step, hard stop on overrun

check.ci: a step that exceeds its ledger aborts; usage is checked first
